answer: Make every agent carry one GS1 Company Prefix as its beacon: GS1 issues a prefix only after checking a business's incorporation papers, and anyone can verify it in the public GEPIR registry. A forger wanting 1,000 fake agents must buy 1,000 prefixes — GS1 US charges $250 plus $50 a year for the smallest, so the bill reaches $300,000 before a single fake trade. Abuse leaves a signal: duplicate prefixes surface in GEPIR, and one exposed prefix collapses the karst of shell firms behind it, since every fake drained through the same hollow entry.
